title: Design An Ordered Stream
description: Maintain a stream of values and return a chunk of values whenever the next expected index is inserted.
pseudocode:
1: ptr = 1
2: stream = new Array(n + 1)
3: if idKey == ptr:
4:   stream[idKey] = value
5:   res = []
6:   while ptr < stream.length and stream[ptr]:
7:     res.push(stream[ptr])
8:     ptr++
9:   return res
10: else:
11:   stream[idKey] = value
12:   return []

steps.note: idKey != ptr, store value and return empty
ptr is 1, stream[1] exists. Start chunking.
Increment ptr to 2. stream[2] is null, stop.
